{% if class|slice(0, 16) == 'product-category' or class|slice(0, 15) == 'product-product' %}<script>(function(){var ready=false,activated=false,links=[];var events=['pointerdown','touchstart','keydown','wheel'];function activate(){if(!ready||activated)return;activated=true;links.forEach(function(x){x.link.setAttribute('rel',x.rel);if(x.media===null){x.link.removeAttribute('media');}else{x.link.setAttribute('media',x.media);}if(x.as===null){x.link.removeAttribute('as');}else{x.link.setAttribute('as',x.as);}});events.forEach(function(ev){window.removeEventListener(ev,activate,false);});}function prepare(){var nodes=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('template.wdh-deferred-css'));if(!nodes.length){ready=true;return;}var left=nodes.length;function done(){left--;if(left===0)ready=true;}nodes.forEach(function(t){var src=t.content.querySelector('link');var l=document.createElement('link');Array.prototype.forEach.call(src.attributes,function(a){l.setAttribute(a.name,a.value);});var rel=l.getAttribute('rel')||'stylesheet',media=l.getAttribute('media'),as=l.getAttribute('as');l.setAttribute('rel','preload');l.setAttribute('as','style');l.onload=done;l.onerror=done;t.parentNode.replaceChild(l,t);links.push({link:l,rel:rel,media:media,as:as});});}events.forEach(function(ev){window.addEventListener(ev,activate,{passive:true});});window.addEventListener('load',prepare,{once:true});})();</script>{% endif %}
